subject.title: Separate speech capability controls from voice settings

question: Should local chat read-aloud require the node TTS capability toggle, or should `NodeTtsEnabled` gate only agent/node `tts.speak` access while chat read-aloud continues to follow `VoiceTtsEnabled`?
rationale: Current main and defaults allow chat read-aloud independently of the node TTS capability, so this PR changes an upgrade-visible behavior that needs maintainer intent rather than automation judgment.

options.title: Preserve chat read-aloud compatibility
options.body: Keep chat-local automatic/manual read-aloud controlled by `VoiceTtsEnabled` while leaving `NodeTtsEnabled` as the agent/node capability gate, then update tests and proof.

options.title: Accept the new TTS capability gate
options.body: Merge only with maintainer sign-off that users must enable the TTS capability before any chat read-aloud, plus current-head proof and compatibility notes.

options.title: Defer chat TTS gating
options.body: Land the settings ownership split without changing chat read-aloud gating and track stricter chat TTS policy separately.

recommendation.title: Preserve chat read-aloud compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep chat-local automatic/manual read-aloud controlled by `VoiceTtsEnabled` while leaving `NodeTtsEnabled` as the agent/node capability gate, then update tests and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current chat TTS and fallback behavior traces to their v0.6.12 merge history, making them the best available owner for the compatibility choice.
